q1_issues.issue: (While sk_group_1 prostitution) relates a subset group to a bare kind — neither is an eventuality — and both clauses here are kind-level and reify no eventuality, so the connective rule supplies no endpoints; 'while' is moreover listed among the temporal connectives that take no connective atom at all.

The reduced relative 'related to prostitution' is predicated of the group symbol sk_activities_1 rather than of its members, the pattern the plural rules warn against for a predicate that holds of each member.

q2_gaps: concessive / contrastive 'while' — the instruction set names 'while' only among the temporal connectives that take no connective atom, while its concession/contrast rule would license a surface connective head; nothing resolves which applies, and neither works when both clauses reify no eventuality
notes: The locative-restriction ConditionalProperty for clause 1 (with the proper-noun place as the condition and its Name atom) and the full partitive shape for clause 2 (definite superset, subset, ProportionOf most, Inheritance on the subset) both match the instruction set exactly.
